name: URTC-FLASHER
build: Standalone Python desktop tool. pip install -r requirements.txt; the Qt Quick deck starts with no arguments, --cli is the headless update.
notes: GUI flashing tool (CAN-OTA + full-chip SWD/JTAG), exercised only against a simulated bootloader (MockCAN), never against a real board. The Qt Quick deck is the only window: CAN-OTA update of the main board or the expansion slave (with the downgrade authorisation, F-RAM erase and CAN backup of the running firmware), bit-rate selector and listen-only search, GitHub release download, bus-activity check, Board Snapshot, the device-configuration writes, read-only SWD/JTAG discovery and full-chip SWD/JTAG programming. Deadlines use time.monotonic(), not the civil clock, so a clock change mid-flash cannot shorten or lengthen a timeout.
